name: B&K
source:
B&K is a bite-sized visual novel featuring Bruce the Badger, Kip the Coyote, and an absurd amount of chicken nuggets.  

After Bruce misses his train home, Kip convinces him to wait for the next one at B&K, the fast food restaurant located a block from the station. It may not be the most classy, but late at night, it's everything Bruce could ask for. It even has one of those massive plastic indoor playgrounds. One that Bruce and Kip have definitely outgrown at this point… right?

Hopefully the possum working the register doesn't mind.

[From [url=https://hypernico.itch.io/bk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《B&K》是一部小巧的视觉小说，登场角色有獾布鲁斯、郊狼基普，以及多得离谱的鸡块。

布鲁斯错过了回家的火车，基普便说服他到车站外一个街区的B&K快餐店里等下一班车。这里也许谈不上有格调，但在深夜，布鲁斯已经别无所求。店里甚至还有那种巨大的塑料室内游乐设施。不过，布鲁斯和基普早就过了能玩这个的年纪……对吧？

希望收银的负鼠不会介意。

[摘自[url=https://hypernico.itch.io/bk]Itch.io[/url]]
